name: Access control
usage: Build one guard with createGuard({ tailnetLogins, serviceTokens: serviceTokensFromEnv() }) and pass every app route through guard.protectAll(routes); only /health and /ready stay open. Callers are a tailnet login sent by the local Tailscale proxy (set trustedProxies if the proxy is not on loopback) or a bearer token whose SHA-256 digest is in SERVICE_TOKEN_SHA256_<NAME>. Wrap each route that takes an ID with owned(loadOwner, handler) so another owner's resource answers 404. Call assertAllGuarded(routes) in an app test; routeInventory(routes) is the route list for review.
